# Wind Field Monitoring

Sustained wind speed and central pressure are the primary indicators used to
classify cyclone intensity. Coordination centres should track the storm
track continuously and update the affected-zone forecast at each advisory.

## Multi-Agency Coordination

Response to a landfalling cyclone requires coordination between the
meteorological authority, port authority, power utility and local emergency
management. A single incident command structure should be established
before landfall, not during it.

# Life Safety Precautions

Shelter-in-place guidance should specify a structure's wind rating.
Evacuation of coastal and low-lying areas should begin while lead time still
allows safe road travel.
